subject: ✅ Enrolment Confirmed — $module_code ($module_name)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your enrolment in the module below is confirmed. The module is now on your study record and will appear on your timetable from the start of teaching.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ENROLMENT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:        $student_id
Module Code:       $module_code
Module Title:      $module_name
Credits:           $credits
Academic Year:     $academic_year
Semester / Term:   $semester
Enrolment Date:    $enrolment_date
Mode of Study:     $mode_of_study

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT TO DO NEXT

  • Check your timetable — the first session is on $first_session_date.
  • Review the module handbook and reading list on the Student Portal.
  • Join the module communication channel if your tutor has set one up.
  • Make sure your finance status is clear — outstanding tuition fees can block module access.

If you change your mind, you can drop the module via Student Tools before the drop deadline ($drop_deadline). After that, withdrawal counts against your record.

Welcome to the module!

Kind regards,
Academic Registry
